Exclusion criteria involve factors such as failure to attend prenatal check-ups, current mental health disorders related to psychosis or substance abuse, suicidality, obstetric complications, use of certain medications, and complicating pediatric medical conditions in newborns. The trial targets various mental health disorders and pregnancy-related conditions, with specific ICD-10 codes provided for reference.

The sample provided is for a phase II clinical trial involving patients with breast cancer. The trial is testing the drug tamoxifen. The inclusion criteria specify that eligible participants must be women with histologically confirmed breast cancer, aged between 18 and 80 years old, with specific menopausal status criteria. Patients must have ER-positive and HER2-negative status, and their disease must be inoperable locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer that is refractory to aromatase inhibitors. Patients must have received a maximum of 2 previous lines of chemotherapy for metastatic breast cancer and have a performance status of ≤ 2. Other criteria include the ability to swallow and retain oral medication, specific lesion measurements, and adequate bone marrow and organ function. Exclusion criteria include previous treatment with certain inhibitors, more than 2 lines of chemotherapy, brain metastasis, other malignancies, significant cardiovascular disease, major bowel resection, inflammatory bowel disease, concurrent immunosuppressive therapy, participation in other clinical trials, and inability or unwillingness to comply with the protocol. The trial is associated with the ICD-10 code C96.Z.

The sample provided is for a phase II clinical trial focusing on patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). The trial is investigating the drug formoterol fumarate for patients aged 40 and above with stable moderate to severe COPD. Inclusion criteria include specific age and COPD diagnosis requirements, smoking history, lung function measurements, and certain female patient criteria. Exclusion criteria involve conditions such as asthma, recent hospitalization for COPD exacerbation, respiratory infections, cardiovascular issues, and specific medical conditions like prostatic hypertrophy and glaucoma. The trial also lists ICD-10 codes related to respiratory and cardiovascular diseases.

The sample represents a clinical trial in phases 1 and 2 involving the treatment of various diseases related to neoplasms, particularly focusing on mesothelioma. The drug being studied is pemetrexed, and its chemical structure is represented by a SMILES string. The sample is a clinical trial for patients with histologically confirmed solid malignancy in advanced stages. The trial is for patients who may benefit from radiotherapy and have at least one accessible lesion for needle localization and catheter placement. Patients must be 18 years or older with a performance status of 0-4 and a life expectancy of at least 2 months. They must meet specific hematopoietic, hepatic, renal, and other health criteria. Patients should not be pregnant or nursing, must have a negative pregnancy test, and should not have any medical or psychiatric conditions that would prevent them from giving informed consent. Additionally, patients should not have a known hypersensitivity to sargramostim (gm-csf) or any of its components. Prior biologic therapy is allowed, but no concurrent biologic therapy is permitted. Chemotherapy, endocrine therapy, and radiotherapy are allowed if they meet certain criteria. Surgery is also allowed, and patients should not have received radiosensitizers within the last 14 days. No other concurrent investigational therapy is allowed.

The sample is for a phase II clinical trial involving patients with neoplasms, specifically breast cancer. The trial is testing the drugs lapatinib and paclitaxel. The eligibility criteria include having histologically confirmed invasive breast cancer with stage IV disease, documented amplification of ERBB2, and having received no more than one prior chemotherapeutic regimen in the metastatic setting. Other criteria include having measurable disease, normal organ and marrow function, a certain cardiac ejection fraction, and being free of certain gastrointestinal diseases. Women must be at least 18 years old, with specific child-bearing potential requirements. Exclusion criteria include having received more than one prior chemotherapeutic regimen in the metastatic setting, prior treatment with lapatinib, and concurrent anticancer or concomitant radiotherapy treatment. The sample also includes a list of ICD-10 codes related to the diseases being studied.

The sample is for a phase II clinical trial involving patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma. The trial is investigating the use of the drug tretinoin. The eligibility criteria include having histologically confirmed metastatic renal cell carcinoma, measurable disease, no active brain metastases, and meeting specific health criteria such as age, performance status, blood counts, liver function, kidney function, and more. Patients must not have certain medical conditions or history of specific diseases, and they must use contraception if fertile. Prior therapy restrictions are also outlined. The trial is focused on patients with specific ICD-10 codes related to urologic neoplasms and kidney neoplasms.

The sample represents a clinical trial in phase 2 or phase 3 focusing on the treatment of vertebral compression fractures using the drug denosumab. The trial is specifically targeting individuals aged between 50 and 90 years old who have been diagnosed with 1 or 2 segment vertebral compression fractures from T4 to L5, with a bone mineral density T value less than -1. Participants must have a recent fracture history of less than 6 weeks and show bone marrow edema of the fractured vertebrae on MRI. Symptoms include low back pain and local paravertebral tenderness.

The inclusion criteria specify the age range, fracture diagnosis, bone density, recent fracture history, MRI findings, and specific symptoms. The exclusion criteria list conditions that would disqualify participants, such as intervertebral fissure, infection, malignancy, neurological dysfunction, previous use of anti-osteoporosis drugs, inability to undergo MRI, prior back surgery, and other contraindications for elective surgery.

The trial is associated with the ICD-10 code 'M96.A3', which likely corresponds to the diagnosis of vertebral compression fractures.

This sample represents a Phase 2 clinical trial focusing on jaw abnormalities and related musculoskeletal conditions. The sample is for a phase II clinical trial focusing on urinary bladder diseases, urologic diseases, and related conditions in male and female participants aged 2-15 years.
